# Sathuthuka Driving School

> Sathuthuka Driving School, based in Verulam, has taught people across KwaZulu-Natal to drive for over 30 years. It offers manual and automatic Code 8 lessons, Code 10 and Code 14 truck training, motorcycle training, defensive driving and learner's licence preparation, with pick-up for lessons anywhere in Durban and eThekwini. Open Monday to Saturday, 08:00–17:00. Learn to drive. Learn to arrive. The site also offers a free K53 study guide, exam-style practice tests, road-sign and road-rule notes, study videos and testing-centre search.

## Key facts

- The learner's licence test has three separately scored sections: Rules of the Road, Road Traffic Signs and Vehicle Controls.
- Minimum scores are 22/28 for Rules of the Road, 23/28 for Road Traffic Signs and 6/8 for Vehicle Controls.
- Candidates must pass all three sections.
- Official learner's licence categories are Code 1, Code 2 and Code 3.
